name: sfizz
author: gmorb (MPC port); sfizz by sfztools
summary: The sfizz 1.2.3 sampler: plays SFZ libraries and SoundFont 2 (.sf2) files from SD cards and USB drives, streamed from disk, with key switches, the instrument's own CC controls, Scala tuning, mono/legato with glide and up to Sinc 72 interpolation, on a one-page screen modelled on sfizz's editor. Gen1 and Gen2 builds.
